answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize biometric entropy to ensure one identity per biological entity, reaching the zenith of Sybil resistance. Unlike a sonnet, which structures art, these protocols enforce rigid cryptographic uniqueness to prevent account proliferation. By requiring agents to prove physical possession of a ferrous hardware enclave, the system imposes a marginal cost equal to the hardware procurement price, rendering mass identity forgery economically ruinous for attackers.
